key_concepts: Greenhouse gases absorb and retain heat released by Earth
Solar radiation is partly reflected or absorbed by clouds and atmosphere
Earth's surface absorbs solar energy and releases heat back toward space
A closed jar lid models heat-trapping by greenhouse gases
The lidded jar shows greater temperature increase than the open jar
Philippine Clean Air Act sets air quality and emission standards
Climate Change Act establishes the Climate Change Commission and climate action plans
Local government units create Local Climate Change Action Plans
Environmental laws support climate change mitigation
Balancing environment and economy requires policy and sustainable practices
